text_block_list.text:
With Valentine's Day approaching,
I went to check out this year's chocolate selection
with Eishin Flash, but—

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I was in line first, you know!
...Ouch, you're bumping into me!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerks
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, customers looking for "Rittersport",
the end of the line is over here— Please do not run!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Quite an uproar, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't be able to take my time looking at the showcase.
It can't be helped...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've already ordered the items I definitely wanted online,
so shall we head home for today?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've seen that sight a few times since coming to Japan... but it always feels so mysterious to me.
choice_data_list: Is it different from Germany after all?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In Germany we also give gifts
on Valentine's Day, but flowers are the most common.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Also, giving gifts to anyone other than your partner...
So-called "obligation chocolate" is not a thing either.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Back home, I watched my father give my mother a bouquet of roses every single year.
choice_data_list: Giving a gift to someone dear is the same either way, huh?
Giving a gift to someone dear is the same either way, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I think that's a little off.
In Germany, we don't give gifts as a confession of love."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've also wondered about this... Why do people confess their feelings on Valentine's Day?
choice_data_list: Isn't it because it gives you a push forward?

text_block_list.text:
Setting a specific date helps organize one's feelings.
And using Valentine's Day makes for an easy excuse, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, an excuse, then...
I generally understand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "However, confessing your feelings is an act that fundamentally alters your relationship with someone."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "In that case, rather than making plans out of the blue, conveying our feelings regularly so the other party can be prepared would be the more considerate approach."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't say for certain just yet,
so could you give me a little time?"
choice_data_list: You really don't have to take it that seriously, though...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I'd like some time to sort my thoughts out.
...At any rate, let's head back for now.
And then, the day of Valentine's arrived—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Here, please take this.
It's chocolate cake."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Why is there a question mark on your face?
This is a bona fide Valentine's gift, you know.
choice_data_list: But you said you weren't giving any giri-choco.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I gave it a lot of thought since then, and
I concluded that giving a present is an easy-to-understand
way to express one's feelings to another.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"So this time, I decided on courtesy chocolate.
It's just an expression of daily gratitude,
so it has nothing to do with confessions."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I think I might understand a little better now
how people feel when giving chocolates on Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Because I want to see the look on their face
when they're surprised by an unexpected gift and wonder what it means.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Our homeroom teacher mentioned they wanted to
speak with you, do you have time right now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll wait here.
I'll review the training schedule in the meantime.
My conversation with Eishin Flash's homeroom teacher ended up being mostly casual small talk about how exceptionally outstanding she is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall head back. We will discuss
the schedule at tomorrow's 9:00 AM meeting.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Regarding what we discussed the other day about everyday ways to convey your feelings to someone...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I think all you can do is just
sincerely show them that you care.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet mere kindness will not do.
There must always be something to 'give.'

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Suppose, for instance, there is someone who doesn't usually display flowers.
Let's say you decide to give that person flowers as a present.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The other person may feel the flowers day by day.
However, flowers will eventually wither, and the time will come to throw them away."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That is the very moment they first realize a brand-new option has opened up in their life.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And... perhaps
they'll remember the person who gave it to them as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, that's all for me.
Excuse me.

After Eishin Flash left,
I suddenly caught a pleasant scent, and—

A deep crimson rose, smooth as velvet,
swayed gently in the breeze.
